purpose: Record the CP84-validated TL2 Shield Capacity 3 working candidate while retaining Shield 4 only as an upper sensitivity; recharge, hardening, Installation Space, damage-condition behavior, and other defensive properties remain separate.

tl2SensitivityCandidates.interpretation: CP84 native evidence supports Capacity 3 at the unchanged 3-Space footprint as the current TL2 working candidate. It crosses the standard Kinetic shield-facing packet breakpoint but does not broadly dominate every weapon family.
Intentional upper bound to expose integer damage/recharge breakpoints; not a default promotion target.

informationControlEnvironments.description: Unjammed Firm control with +12 TL2 Tactical Computer assistance.
Contemporary TL2 DR1 Sensor + reactive ECCM1 against ECM2; explicitly exercises recharge competition with support power.

promotionBoundary: Shield Capacity 3 is a validated working candidate, not yet production component data.
Shield Capacity 4 remains an upper sensitivity and is not promoted at TL2.
Future shield progression must treat capacity, recharge, hardening, Space, efficiency, and condition behavior as separate properties unless separately validated.

nativeEvidence.finding: Shield 3 is a validated TL2 working candidate; Shield 4 remains an upper sensitivity because it crosses the standard Missile shield-facing packet breakpoint and produced much stronger defensive effects.
